newsitem.title: USA: Tokheim sees Q3 charge to move operation.
newsitem.headline: Tokheim sees Q3 charge to move operation.

text.p: Tokheim Corp, which makes gas pumps and service station equipment, said its fiscal 1997 third quarter results will be reduced by about $900,000 to cover costs of transferring its operations in Germany to the United Kingdom.
Tokheim acquired Sofitam International, a larger competitor, in September 1996 and said its post-merger restructuring and consolidation plan is on schedule.
In addition, Tokheim said it has paid down $42.6 million of the $174.5 million in bank debt incurred to complete the acquisition.
International business, excluding exports from the United States, now comprise more than 50 percent of total sales, up from 20 percent last year before the merger.

Tokheim reported earnings for its fiscal second quarter ended May 31, 1997, rose to $1.2 million or $0.15 a share from $500,000 or $0.06 in the year ago quarter. Fiscal second quarter sales jumped 66 percent from last year to $95.9 million.
